title: Record the purchase. See what’s left.
description: A manual expense tracker with no bank connection. A short entry after a purchase, categories that make sense, and a history you can keep separately.

blocks.text: Some people choose manual expense entry on purpose. What matters to them is linking a purchase to a category themselves and seeing how it affected the balance. So the absence of bank import can be a deliberate choice rather than a shortcoming.

quote.text: This app is exactly what my husband and I needed to get our spending under control. I love that it DOES NOT sync to your bank accounts which inevitably results in mistakes when purchases are mis-categorized. I love that it forces me to be INTENTIONAL about my spending.

blocks.text: Record the amount first, and let the category and the note be added without a long mandatory form. After saving, show the new balance and allow a mistake to be undone. Later you can come back to the purchases that still lack context.

Test recording several real purchases over the course of a day. The person should be able to find the purchase they want and explain the change in the amount. Speed of entry is useful if the records stay clear and don’t require a parallel list.
